description: This file defines a custom exception class 'GrainReferenceNotBoundException' used in the Orleans runtime to indicate that a 'GrainReference' was not properly bound before use.

classes.name: GrainReferenceNotBoundException
classes.description: A sealed class representing an exception thrown when a GrainReference is used without being bound to the runtime.

methods.name: GrainReferenceNotBoundException(GrainReference)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a message indicating the GrainReference was not bound.

methods.name: GrainReferenceNotBoundException(string)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a custom message.

methods.name: GrainReferenceNotBoundException(string, Exception)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a custom message and inner exception.
